To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
neural network based fraud models are significantly more effective at detecting credit card fraud, in terms of both accuracy and earliness, than rule-based fraud detection procedures.

(1) a neural network can be trained to detect credit card fraud; (2) the network can detect a large number of fraudulent accounts; (3) the network can do so with a very low false alarm rate (less than 1/10 of the rate of the rule based system); and (4) the network can be used to detect fraud in real time, i.e., the network is able to detect fraud within a few days of its occurrence.

1. The neural network based fraud detector outperformed a rule based fraud detection procedure in a credit card fraud environment, 2. The neural network outperformed a linear regression based fraud detection procedure, and 3. The neural network performed well in terms of earliness of fraud discovery.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of neural networks for fraud detection on credit card account transactions.
the development and application of neural network technology to the detection of credit card fraud.
the use of neural networks to solve real world problems in the financial services industry.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
neural networks have the potential to improve the accuracy of the fraud detection process and to detect more fraud earlier.
the neural network based fraud system has performed well in terms of detection of fraud, detection of false positives and the earliness of detection.
the network is an effective fraud detection system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have demonstrated the use of neural networks to perform fraud detection on a large scale credit card portfolio.

we have demonstrated that neural networks can learn to detect fraud on credit card transactions with a high level of accuracy, that they can learn from a relatively small number of labelled examples, and that the resulting network can be used to detect fraud in real time.
we have shown how a neural network can be used to solve a real world, complex, and important problem in a better way than existing methods, with a substantial reduction in the cost of the solution.
The main takeaway from our work is that
neural networks can be trained to perform credit card fraud detection with very good results, even on data that is very noisy.
neural networks can be used to solve real-world credit card fraud detection problems with a significant improvement in performance over rule-based approaches.
the use of neural networks in fraud detection can lead to significant improvements in detection accuracy and earlines of fraud detection over traditional rule based systems.
